name: FiveM (FXServer)
author: aetheris-project
description: FiveM FXServer with automatic artifact resolution, license key, server profile and resource hosting.
startup: cd /home/container && ./alpine/opt/cfx-server/ld-musl-x86_64.so.1 --library-path ./alpine/usr/lib/v8/ ./alpine/opt/cfx-server/FXServer +set citizen_dir ./alpine/opt/cfx-server/citizen/ +set sv_licenseKey ${FIVEM_LICENSE} +set steam_webApiKey ${STEAM_WEB_API_KEY} +set sv_hostname "${SERVER_NAME}" +set sv_maxPlayers ${MAX_PLAYERS} +set sv_port ${SERVER_PORT} +set serverProfile default +exec server.cfg

installation.script:
# @author Aetheris Project
# @description FiveM install script
# @user-alpine

apt-get update -y
apt-get install -y curl unzip jq

mkdir -p /home/container/logs
cd /home/container

ARTIFACT_URL=$(curl -s https://changelogs-ci.fivem.net/runtime/${FIVEM_ARTIFACT:-latest}/linux_x64 | jq -r .url)
if [ -z "${ARTIFACT_URL}" ]; then
  echo "Could not resolve the FiveM artifact URL." >&2
  exit 1
fi
curl -s -o fivem.tar.gz "${ARTIFACT_URL}"
tar -xzf fivem.tar.gz
rm -f fivem.tar.gz

cat > server.cfg <<EOF
endpoint_add_tcp "0.0.0.0:${SERVER_PORT:-30120}"
endpoint_add_udp "0.0.0.0:${SERVER_PORT:-30120}"
sv_hostname "${SERVER_NAME:-Aetheris FiveM}"
sv_maxplayers ${MAX_PLAYERS:-48}
sv_licenseKey "${FIVEM_LICENSE:-changeme}"
sv_port ${SERVER_PORT:-30120}
EOF

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Server name shown in the FiveM list.

variables.name: Steam Web API Key
variables.description: Steam web API key for server listing (optional).

variables.name: Artifact Version
variables.description: FXServer artifact version (latest or a specific build).
